summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K reporting completion on October 7, 2026 of previously announced exchange offers and consent solicitations for Qorvo notes, tied to its acquisition of Qorvo. Skyworks issued up to $850M of new 4.375% 2029 notes and $700M of new 3.375% 2031 notes for tendered Qorvo notes. Accepted amounts were $779.384M of 2029 notes and $647.096M of 2031 notes, leaving $70.616M and $52.904M outstanding. Offers expired October 5, 2026. This is routine acquisition-related debt exchange mechanics, not a standalone special situation; watch residual notes and integration financing.
